content.text: When trying to use a S3 compatible storage [1] [2], in our case Ceph (Luminous), we get an exception [3].

While trying to debug the problem I set up nginx as S3 Proxy for aws (configuration below) and found out that the same error appears when using this setup [4] (I set up a local dns resolver for this).
When removing the redirect and accessing aws directly everything works fine. Tried using other S3-Proxy solutions as well.
Sending 1 byte files throws the same exception and uploading empty files creates exception [5]. If you need access to a Ceph S3 instance for testing I will provide one on our test installation.

fields.summary: Failed to reset the input stream when not accessing s3 directly or s3 compatible gateway

renderedFields.description:
When trying to use a S3 compatible storage [1] [2], in our case Ceph (Luminous), we get an exception [3].
While trying to debug the problem I set up nginx as S3 Proxy for aws (configuration below) and found out that the same error appears when using this setup [4] (I set up a local dns resolver for this).
When removing the redirect and accessing aws directly everything works fine. Tried using other S3-Proxy solutions as well.

Sending 1 byte files throws the same exception and uploading empty files creates exception [5]. If you need access to a Ceph S3 instance for testing I will provide one on our test installation.

kind regards,
ts

gzip_proxied any;
gzip_types text/plain application/json;

server {
listen 80;
server_name .s3-proxy .s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com;
client_max_body_size 10g;

access_log /var/log/nginx/s3proxy-access.log;
error_log /var/log/nginx/s3proxy-error.log;

proxy_set_header Host $host;
proxy_buffering off;

location /

{ fastcgi_pass_header Authorization; fastcgi_pass_request_headers on; include fastcgi_params; proxy_pass https://52.216.101.21; proxy_pass_header Server; proxy_http_version 1.1; proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade; proxy_set_header Connection 'upgrade'; proxy_set_header Host $host; proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for; proxy_cache_bypass $http_upgrade; }

}
